method: Material Adjusted Close factor changes flagged by audit-prices and reviewed against SEC dividend facts or a reviewed price correction. An entry accepts only the exact ticker, date and factor change; a new or changed event still needs review. Amounts are per share on the vendor's price basis, implied by the factor change and the previous Close.
